Name: Overgrown Flowery Interface - Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted) compatibility
Author: NovaStarPrime16
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I made this as a personal edit for Survivalistic Rebooted and realized I probably wasn't the only one wanting it. [b][i]Neither mod is mine, i only made this edit[/i]![/b]    

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
This is an asset replacement for the hunger and thirst bars, you have to override the files in Survivalistic Rebooted manually

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This is png replacements for Survivalistic Rebooted to match Overgrown Flowery Interface. it is unlikely to be maintained unless major changes happen to either mod

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted) and Overgrown Flowery Interface plus their requirements

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to Locked15 for Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted) and Orphaneom for the original Survivalistic as well as SugarSugarRuin for Overgrown Flowery Interface
